summary: Accumulus Advisory is a small Essendon (VIC) accounting and virtual CFO practice. Lucy Boulos and Paul Herczaniwski took over as directors in April 2025 and marked one year with an office fit-out. Lucy posted in February 2026 about Payday Super and AML reforms, and the firm offers fixed-price bookkeeping with BAS and Xero cloud accounting.

sources.title: Tax Accountants & Business Consulting Essendon | Accumulus Advisory
Two-day seminar: Payday Super and AML - Lucy Boulos

claims.text: Accumulus Advisory is based at 74A Lincoln Road, Essendon VIC 3040.
Lucy Boulos is Director & Partner at Accumulus Advisory (since April 2025).
Lucy and Paul Herczaniwski stepped into the business in April 2025 and marked their first year on 1 April 2026.
claims.quote: Today marks one year since myself and Paul Herczaniwski stepped into the business and began the next chapter of Accumulus Advisory.

claims.text: For the first anniversary Lucy said the firm completed a full office fit-out.
claims.quote: we've completed a full office fit-out, creating a space that reflects how we work

claims.text: Lucy posted after a two-day seminar that Payday Super means super must be paid with wages from 1 July 2026, calling it a cashflow and systems shift.
claims.quote: From 1 July 2026, super must be paid at the same time as wages — not quarterly. It's a real cashflow and systems shift.

claims.text: Lucy said the firm is already modelling cashflow and reviewing payroll processes with clients for Payday Super.
claims.quote: we're starting the conversations now — modelling cashflow, reviewing payroll processes and tightening onboarding procedures.

claims.text: Accumulus offers Virtual CFO services for small businesses.
claims.quote: All the advantages of a full-time accountant, for a part-time fee.

claims.text: Bookkeeping is sold as fixed-price packages, with BAS lodged for small to large businesses.
claims.quote: Our bookkeeping service packages are made for small business owners

claims.text: Accumulus sits down with bookkeeping clients after each BAS period to review their profit and loss.
claims.quote: We sit down with you after each BAS period to chat about your profit and loss

claims.text: Accumulus moved client Bradmac Airconditioning from an offline system to Xero and the case study reports saved duplicated manual tasks.
claims.quote: managed to save thousands of dollars in duplication manual tasks

claims.text: The firm's clients range from cafes and consultants to property developers, wholesalers and retailers.
claims.quote: Our clients include cafes to B2B enterprises, consultants, property developers to sole traders, wholesalers, retailers, tradies and many more
Accumulus Advisory employs 6 people, founded in 2016.

hooks.text: Lucy's Payday Super post: payroll and cashflow modelling with clients is new recurring reconciliation work.
Post-BAS profit and loss review with each bookkeeping client depends on clean, reconciled books first.
New directors one year in, investing in the practice (office fit-out), likely open to improving how work is done.

risks.text: Very small team (6), so volume may be modest.

gaps: No job ads, podcasts, Facebook or news coverage found.
No explicit mention of Dext, Hubdoc or other automation tools.
